data.display_address: The Binary Tower, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover an exceptional commercial opportunity in the heart of Business Bay — one of Dubai’s most prestigious business districts. This spacious and modern office space in The Binary Tower is perfectly suited for businesses looking to establish themselves in a vibrant, high-growth area with premium infrastructure and easy accessibility.

Property Details:

Condition: Ready to be used for your business needs
Usage: Office / Restaurant / Café (Provisions for water and drainage available)

Views:

Stunning Dubai Creek views
Captivating Downtown Dubai skyline views
Building Status: New & well-maintained with modern architecture

Highlights & Features:

Flexible layout to accommodate open-plan or partitioned office design
Water and drainage provisions make it suitable for F&B businesses
Abundant natural light with panoramic windows
High-speed elevators and professional lobby area
24/7 Security and CCTV monitoring
Ample visitor and tenant parking
Close proximity to public transport and main roads

Prime Location – Business Bay

5 minutes to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall
15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
10 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road

Why Business Bay?

Business Bay is rapidly transforming into Dubai’s central business district, attracting multinational companies, entrepreneurs, and start-ups. It offers a dynamic, professional environment complete with top-tier office buildings, luxury hotels, fine dining, and vibrant retail options. It’s the ideal location for businesses seeking prestige and convenience in the heart of the city.
